Stress Level Checker

The real 10-item Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10) with standard scoring bands.

Stress level

Screening tool, not a diagnosis. If stress is affecting your life, consider talking to a professional. For information only — not medical advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Answer all 10 questions about the last month honestly.
  2. Use the scale from Never (0) to Very often (4).
  3. Click Calculate score.
  4. Read your score out of 40 and the low / moderate / high band.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do the scores mean?

0-13 is considered low stress, 14-26 moderate, 27-40 high perceived stress, using the standard PSS-10 bands.

Why are some questions reversed?

Four items are worded positively, so 'Very often' on those means less stress. They are reverse-scored automatically.

Is this a diagnosis?

No. It is a screening tool that measures perceived stress, not a medical or psychological diagnosis.
